relation: Unconditional equivalence of the frozen pre-M1 edge-comprehension family and the public indexed family of subsets of E(G); the live source is a transparent alias.
summary: C4 migrates the compiled X15 indexed edge family: every member is a subset of E(G), with no cover, disjointness, nonempty-member or positive-index requirement. Overlap, repetition and empty members remain allowed; zero indices are vacuous on every graph.

C1 already froze the original helper, pre-M1 edge set, original matching, and all four full statements. The snapshots and all old theorem types are unchanged; only the C1 helper bridge unfolds the public alias. C2/C3 entry points remain unchanged.

The corpus underrepresentation row and its three explicit-constant LLM variants retain their different bounds, quantifier order, bipartiteness and positive-Delta guard, and natural-number floor/ceiling arithmetic. The existing fair_matching proof consumers and registered formal resolution retain their statements and status.

The public-only client covers membership, shrinking and arbitrary reindexing, repeated overlapping members on K2, zero indices on K2, empty members, and rejection of singleton-vertex and empty-vertex-set edges. X15alone stays excluded and unchanged.
